cycle_ledger.interpretation: All 350 observed counter-advance intervals incremented once; this sampled transition ledger remains distinct from complete event-ledger cycles.

exported_metabolic_rate_channels.reason: The receipt-bound 60-column resting-coupled.csv exports oxygen and CO2 inventory error diagnostics but no per-step VO2/VCO2 metabolic flux or consumption channel.

limitations: This is the closed control arm only. The treatment arm, paired primary effect, and registered study verification were not examined.
The model includes perfusion-to-gas transport and gas-driven chemoreflex regulation; this baseline report does not claim those are absent.
Respiratory pressure/volume does not feed back into cardiovascular hemodynamics in the current model, and whole-body modal response is not represented.
Generic ranges are measurement-dependent descriptive references from the existing Human owner, not clinical thresholds or acceptance gates.

dose.limitations: General reference intervals depend on age, altitude and measurement method. Comparisons describe model outputs; they do not establish anatomical validity, numerical conservation, population generalization or clinical validation. Missing complete-cycle rates remain unavailable.

supine_male_cohort_context.scope: Published cohort mean/SD, not normal bounds or a clinical gate. OEP chest-wall tidal volume is a related measurement, not identical to model airway volume.

supine_pulmonary_pressure_review_context.scope: Published right-heart-catheterization review mean/SD, not individual normal bounds or a clinical gate. This posture-specific context supplements the unchanged AACN comparison; it does not replace a failed comparison or tune the model.
supine_pulmonary_pressure_review_context.source_location: Kovacs et al. 2009, abstract, healthy subjects at rest in the supine position
